titleTr: Koşul cümleleri ve wish: okulda ilk gün

explainTr: Koşul cümlesi dört temel kalıpta toplanır: zero (genel gerçek) if + present, present. Type 1 (gerçekçi gelecek) if + present, will. Type 2 (şu an gerçek dışı) if + past, would. Type 3 (geçmişte olmadı) if + past perfect, would have + V3.

Wish aynı mantığı izler: şimdiki pişmanlık için wish + past (I wish I had more time), geçmiş pişmanlık için wish + past perfect (I wish I had left earlier). Başkasının can sıkıcı alışkanlığı için wish + would kullanılır.
En sık hata: if cümlesine will veya would koymak. 'If I will go' yanlış; 'If I go' doğru. Unless = if not olduğu için yanında ayrıca olumsuz kullanılmaz.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'Gelirsen görürsün', 'Gelseydin görürdün', 'Gelmiş olsaydın görmüş olurdun' hep ek ile kurulur. İngilizcede ek yok; zaman kayması var: present, past, past perfect. 'Keşke' için wish kullanılır.
table: If it rains, we stay inside.
If you come, I will help.
If I were you, I would call.
if + past perfect, would have + V3

exercises.q: If it rains tomorrow, the students ___ recess inside.
exercises.whyTr: Gerçekçi gelecek ihtimali (type 1): if + present, will + fiil.

exercises.q: If I were the principal, I ___ more time for lunch.
exercises.whyTr: Gerçek dışı şimdiki durum (type 2): would + yalın fiil.

exercises.q: If she had known about the drill, she ___ the students earlier.
exercises.whyTr: Geçmişte olmamış şey (type 3): would have + V3.

exercises.q: I wish I ___ more patience with noisy kids.
I wish I ___ the sub plan yesterday. Then I wouldn't have been lost.

exercises.answer: If students arrive late they must sign in

reading.title: Hafsa's first morning at Jefferson Elementary
reading.text:
Hafsa's first day at Jefferson Elementary started with a surprise. Mr. Brown handed her a folder and said, "Mrs. Patel is sick today, so you will teach fifth grade. Her sub plan is inside." Hafsa's heart beat fast. If she had arrived five minutes earlier, she would have had time to read the whole plan. Instead, she had to read it while the students were walking in.

The first twenty minutes were not easy. Two boys, Jason and Miguel, kept talking during the reading lesson. At first Hafsa pretended not to notice. She wished she had set clear rules at the beginning. Then she remembered something Linda had told her: "If you are consistent, children will respect you." So Hafsa stopped, stood quietly in front of the class, and waited. After a few seconds the room became silent.

"Here is how we will work today," she said in a calm but firm voice. "If you want to ask a question, raise your hand. If everyone finishes the worksheet, we will have ten extra minutes of free reading." The students looked surprised, but they listened. When Jason started to tease Miguel again, Hafsa stepped in. She did not shout. She asked them to explain the problem, and soon they agreed to sit apart for the rest of the morning. It was a small compromise, but it worked.

At lunch, the teacher next door, Mr. Davis, stopped by. "I heard it was quiet in your room," he smiled. "If I were you, I would be proud." Hafsa laughed. "I wish I could say I wasn't nervous," she answered. "I was shaking inside." Mr. Davis shook his head. "That's normal. If you never felt nervous, you probably wouldn't care about the students."

In the afternoon, Hafsa left a note for Mrs. Patel describing the day. Before she went home, Mr. Brown asked if she could return on Friday. "If you are free, we would love to have you," he said. Hafsa smiled all the way to the bus stop.

script.speaker: Mr. Davis
script.text: Hafsa, do you have a minute? I want to share a few tips for tomorrow.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Of course, Mr. Davis. I wish I had known all this today!

script.speaker: Mr. Davis
script.text: Don't worry. First, if a student arrives late, send him to the front office for a tardy slip.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Okay. And if a student feels sick?

script.speaker: Mr. Davis
script.text: Send him to the nurse, but always with a buddy. Never alone.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: That makes sense. What happens if there is a fire drill?

script.speaker: Mr. Davis
script.text: Take the roster from the desk and line the students up quietly. If you forget it, the office can print another one.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: I will keep it near the door. Anything else?

script.speaker: Mr. Davis
script.text: One more thing. If two students argue, don't shout. Speak quietly, and they will usually calm down.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: That worked this morning. Thank you for your advice.

script.speaker: Mr. Davis
script.text: If I were you, I would write these tips in a notebook.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Good idea. I will do it tonight.

writing.promptTr: Bir öğretmen arkadaşına yaz (120-180 kelime): Sınıfta öğrenciler gürültü yaparsa ne yaparsın? İdeal bir sınıf için ne dilersin? Koşul cümleleri ve 'wish' kullan.
writing.promptEn: Write a paragraph (120-180 words): What would you do if students were noisy? What do you wish for your ideal classroom? Use conditionals and 'wish'.
frames: If students are noisy, I usually ...
If I were a full-time teacher, I would ...
If I had known ..., I would have ...
writing.model:
If students are noisy, I usually stop talking and wait quietly. Most children notice the silence and calm down in a few seconds. If that doesn't work, I walk to their desks and speak to them in a soft voice. I never shout, because I think shouting teaches children to shout back.

If I were a full-time teacher, I would set clear rules on the first day and repeat them every morning. I would also reward good behavior with small privileges, such as extra reading time. Respect and fairness are very important to me, and I believe students need to feel safe before they can learn.

On my first day as a substitute, I wished I had read the sub plan earlier. If I had arrived ten minutes sooner, I would have felt much calmer. Next time I will come early.

In my ideal classroom, students listen to each other, raise their hands, and help their classmates. I wish every school had enough time and support for teachers to build that kind of community.
checklistTr: Type 1, 2 ve 3 koşul cümlelerinden en az ikisini kullandın mı?
En az bir 'I wish' cümlen var mı?
If'ten sonra will/would kullanmadığını kontrol ettin mi?
Paragrafın başı, gelişmesi ve sonu var mı?

examSet.q: The bell had rung before she ___ the room.
examSet.whyTr: Önce olan iş past perfect (had rung), sonraki iş past simple.

examSet.q: The sub plans ___ on the desk every morning.
examSet.whyTr: Düzenli olay + yapan önemsiz: present passive (are left).

examSet.q: Mr. Brown said that Mrs. Patel ___ sick the day before.
examSet.whyTr: Reported speech'te geçmiş olay past perfect olur.

examSet.q: You ___ leave students alone in the classroom. It is against the rules.
We ___ have called the office, but we didn't know the number.
examSet.whyTr: Geçmişte mümkün olup yapılmayan: could have + V3.

examSet.q: If the fire alarm ___ off, line up quietly.
If she hadn't spoken up yesterday, the problem ___ worse today.
examSet.whyTr: Karışık koşul: geçmiş neden, şimdiki sonuç: would + fiil.

examSet.q: I wish I ___ the answer, but I don't.
If only I ___ to Linda's advice last week!
examSet.whyTr: Geçmiş pişmanlık: If only + past perfect.
